title: Uniqode Review (2026)
intro: Uniqode is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Uniqode (formerly Beaconstac) is a QR code and digital business card platform for creating, branding, and tracking dynamic codes that bridge offline marketing to online experiences. Official pricing FAQ (researched 2026-08-17) states static QR codes are free and dynamic QR starts from about $9/mo with annual billing; plan cards are JS-rendered — confirm live tiers. Business+/enterprise features are custom. Digital cards have separate Team packaging (~$6/user/mo researched — confirm live). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Uniqode when dynamic QR / digital card campaigns are the primary offline→online marketing job.
verdict: Choose Uniqode when dynamic QR / digital card campaigns are the primary offline→online marketing job. Compare free static QR generators for one-offs, landing-page tools when the destination experience is the product, and full MAPs when nurture is the job. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
